member.name: M:ThemeExplorer.Core.VisualStyle.Open(System.IntPtr,System.String,System.String)
member.summary:
Opens a visual style for the given class using a specific window handle. Passing the top-level window matters for per-window themes (custom UXTHEME skins); a zero handle asks UXTHEME for the process/global theme, which can be the default Aero style.
使用指定窗口句柄为给定类打开视觉样式。对于按窗口应用的 自定义 UXTHEME 皮肤，传入顶层窗口句柄很重要；零句柄会取进程/全局主题，可能得到 默认 Aero 样式。
Opens a visual style for a class and optional window subclass. UxTheme stores the subclass on the HWND, so it is applied before OpenThemeData and cleared afterwards.

member.name: T:ThemeExplorer.Core.VisualStyleContext
member.summary:
Owns the hidden helper window that UXTHEME needs in order to apply a window subclass before opening a theme. Create one context per UI thread and reuse it for all instances.
拥有隐藏辅助窗口，UXTHEME 需要它来在打开主题前应用窗口子类。每个 UI 线程创建一个上下文，并对所有 实例复用它。
member.remarks:
The context is not thread safe and is meant to be used on the UI thread.
上下文不是线程安全的，应在 UI 线程上使用。
